3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3069|03b30234.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|03b30234.text: We live and die, and the land remains, eternal, unmoved by our passage. Thus, land cannot belong to us, $N. Instead, we belong to it. Therefore we protect the land, for without it we cannot hope to survive.

3069|655fcf7d.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|655fcf7d.text: You have outgrown any teachings I could offer. Go with the blessing of the Earth Mother. Seek out the $r Tarn in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Be guided by his wisdom.

3069|93940fbb.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|93940fbb.text: Meat, skin, bones... a good hunter lets nothing go to waste. Every scrap of leather can be salvaged, perhaps to reinforce an ally's armor. Thus, each of us is strong alone, but together we become invincible.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1656-complete.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-complete.text:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656-complete.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

96661-progress.name: Pyall Silentstride
96661-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96661-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking
